_comment: Persistent strangle-strategy parameters. Loaded each morning. Changes take effect next trading day. Lot sizes confirmed from Fyers symbol master 2026-06-25: NIFTY=65, SENSEX=20.
_retention_note: 0 = keep all trading days forever (no pruning).
_product_note: MIS or NRML. Zerodha keeps these in SEPARATE margin buckets and does NOT net one against the other, so an MIS short gets ZERO hedge benefit from an NRML long and is charged as fully naked. Match the product your hedges are held in. TRADE-OFF: MIS is auto-squared-off by the broker ~15:20 (a backstop if the engine dies); NRML is not. A leg ALWAYS exits with the product it was opened with.

live_orders._comment: Phase 3 live Zerodha orders. GATES: enabled=run the controller (paper-live watch). mode toggle (paper/live) via the dashboard. allow_live=HARD gate for REAL orders. Real orders fire ONLY when enabled=true AND mode=live AND allow_live=true. For the paper-live watch: enabled=true, mode=paper, allow_live=false (no real orders possible).

kotak_orders._comment: Kotak Neo MIRROR leg — INDEPENDENT of Zerodha: same signal, its OWN engine + own guard/kill, so a failure on either broker never stops the other. Fires 1 lot NRML alongside each Zerodha order. Credentials live ONLY in deployment/.env (KOTAK_CONSUMER_KEY / KOTAK_MOBILE / KOTAK_MPIN / KOTAK_TOTP_SECRET). enabled=false until login+symbol tested and the engine is wired.

google_sheets._comment: V2 P&L logging into the existing 'Trading Journal' sheet. Auth = OAuth (user consent), NOT a service account (org policy blocks SA keys). Put the OAuth Desktop-app client at oauth_client_file, run '--auth' once to cache oauth_token_file, then set spreadsheet_id to the Trading Journal id. One tab PER INDEX (auto-created); PAPER and LIVE rows share a tab, told apart by the Mode column. enabled=false until configured.
google_sheets._live_worksheet_note: EOD live-tab P&L (from the LIVE.json snapshots — real broker fills on live days) upserts one row per index per day into this single tab, keyed by (Date, Index).
